chunks: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Abi Umayr from Aban al-Ahmar from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon him). He said:

A man came to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family), and his garment was worn out. So twelve silver coins were brought to him. He said: O Ali! Take these silver coins and buy a garment for me to wear. Ali (peace be upon him) said: So I went to the market and bought a shirt for him with twelve silver coins. I brought it to the Messenger of Allah, and he looked at it and said: O Ali! A shirt less than this would suffice me. Do you think its owner will take it back? I said: I do not know. He said: Go see. So I went to its owner and said: Indeed the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) has disliked this. He wants a garment less than this. Please take it back. So he returned the silver coins to me.

I came with them to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family). He walked with me to the market to buy a shirt. He saw a slave girl sitting on the road crying. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said to her: What is your matter? She said: O Messenger of Allah! The people of my house gave me four silver coins to purchase a thing for them, but I lost them, and I do not dare to return to them. So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) gave her four silver coins and said: Return to your family.

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) went to the market and bought a shirt for four silver coins. He wore it and praised Allah. He went out and saw a naked man saying: Whoever clothes me, may Allah clothe him with the garments of Paradise. So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) removed his shirt that he had bought and clothed the beggar. Then he returned to the market and bought another shirt with the four that remained. He wore it and praised Allah.

He returned to his house and suddenly the slave girl was sitting on the road. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said to her: Why haven't you gone to your family? She said: O Messenger of Allah! I have delayed in returning to them and I fear that they will beat me. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said to her: Walk in front of me and guide me to your family.

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) came until he stopped at the door of their house. Then he said: Peace be upon you, O people of the house. They did not answer him. He repeated the greeting, they did not answer. He repeated the greeting, and they said: And upon you be peace, O Messenger of Allah, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. He said to them: Why did you not answer my greeting the first and second time? They said: O Messenger of Allah! We heard your greeting and we loved to hear more of it. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: This slave girl has delayed in returning to you, so do not hold her accountable. They said: O Messenger of Allah! She is free because of your coming. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: Praise be to Allah! Never have I seen twelve silver coins of greater blessing than these. Allah clothed two naked people with them and freed a person with them.
ai.seo_question: What is the story of Prophet Muhammad and the twelve silver coins according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (as) narrates a remarkable story about the Prophet Muhammad (s) and twelve silver coins. When the Prophet's garment was worn out, he asked Ali to buy him a new one. Ali bought a shirt for the full twelve coins, but the Prophet found it too expensive and had Ali return it. On the way back to the market together, the Prophet encountered a crying slave girl who had lost four coins her masters had given her. He gave her four coins from his own twelve. With the remaining eight, he bought a cheaper shirt for four coins, praised Allah, but immediately gave it away to a naked man begging for clothes. He bought yet another shirt with the last four coins. Returning home, he found the slave girl still afraid to go back. He personally walked her to her masters' house, where after a triple exchange of greetings, they freed her in honor of the Prophet's visit. The Prophet concluded: 'Never have I seen twelve silver coins of greater blessing — Allah clothed two naked people and freed a person.' The original audience would have understood this as a living demonstration of how every dirham spent in Allah's cause multiplies in blessing.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Aban al-Ahmar from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as).  He said:

A man came to the Messenger of Allah (s), and he (s) had a tattered garment. So, he gave him twelve silver coins. So, he said: O `Ali! Take these silver coins and purchase a garment with it for me.   `Ali (as) said: I went to the market and bought a shirt with the twelve silver coins for him. I took it to the Messenger of Allah. He looked at it and said: O `Ali! I would like something different than this. Do you think the owner will take it back? I said: I do not know. So, he said: Go and see. I went back to the owner and I said: The Messenger of Allah (s) does not like this. He wants another shirt. Please take it back and return the silver coins.

So, I went back to the Messenger of Allah (s) and walked with him to the market to buy a shirt, when we saw a slave girl sitting on the street crying. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said to her: What is your issue? She said: O Messenger of Allah! My master gave me four silver coins to purchase a thing for him, but I lost it, and I do not dare to return to them. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) gave her four silver coins, and he said: Return to your master.

The Messenger of Allah (s) went to the market to purchase a shirt with four silver coins. He wore it, and praised Allah. [On his way back,] he saw a naked man. He was saying: Whoever clothes me, may Allah clothe with the garments of Paradise. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) removed his shirt that he had bought and clothed the beggar. Then, he returned to the market to purchase a shirt with the remaining four silver coins. He wore it and praised Allah.

Upon his return to his house, he saw the slave girl who was sitting on the street crying. So, he (s) said to her: Why haven’t you returned to your master? She said: O Messenger of Allah! I have delayed in returning to them, and I fear that they will beat me. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: Walk in front of me and guide me to your master.

The Messenger of Allah (s) went until he stopped at the door of the house. Then he said: Peace be with you, O people of the house. No one responded to him. The Messenger of Allah repeated the greeting, and no one responded, and he repeated the greeting, and they said: And peace, mercy, and blessings be with you, O Messenger of Allah. So, he (s) said: Why didn't you answer my greeting the first and second [time]? So, they said: O Messenger of Allah! We loved to hear you speak again. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: Here is your slave girl. She has delayed in returning to you, but do not harm her. So, they said: O Messenger of Allah, we will free her because you came. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: Praise be to Allah! Look at what a great blessing these twelve silver coins were. This has clothed two naked people and has freed a person.
